verdict.rationale: uv's docs state it 'Supports Cargo-style workspaces for scalable projects', and uv.lock is described as a cross-platform lockfile, so monorepo workspaces are a claimed first-party capability. The evidence never spells out that members share a single lockfile or how local members depend on each other; 'Cargo-style' only implies this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a single shared workspace lockfile, documentation of cross-linked local or editable workspace dependencies, workspace member configuration details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of monorepo use.
